name: suntrap
title: Suntrap
description: For solar and battery installers: on a roof-slate charcoal ground the services list is one photovoltaic module in an aluminium frame, each service a cobalt cell with clipped corners, its title and price set between two silver busbars, and no blue anywhere else.

tokens.--font-display: headings, the business name, prices and dates on cells, phone numbers, figures in tables and customer quotes (a wide geometric sans)
tokens.--font-body: body text, the menu and the name under a quote
tokens.--text-s: small text: descriptions and the word before a price in list cells, labels, dates, table headings, footer
tokens.--text-m: base body size; cell titles when cells stand two abreast on a phone
tokens.--text-l: cell titles and prices, the business name, the standfirst, customer quotes, small headings
tokens.--text-xl: section headings, the number in the call block and the price on a service page
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of headings, prices and phone numbers
tokens.--tracking: letter spacing of headings and the business name
tokens.--color-bg: page background, and the letters of selected text
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, links, the current menu item, the mark beside the business name, the keyboard focus ring and the ground of selected text
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: the standfirst, labels, menu links, table headings, the name under a quote, footer
tokens.--color-accent: busbar silver on the page: the line under every link, the thick rules over tables, the checklist (and its ticks) and the call block, the rule beside a quote, the mark under the current menu item, the outline of the phone button
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines: under the header, between table rows, checklist lines and call-block rows, round code blocks, above the footer
tokens.--color-cell: the solar cells, the only blue: every service in the module and the heading cell of a service page
tokens.--color-on-cell: titles and prices on a cell, and the focus ring inside one
tokens.--color-on-cell-soft: descriptions, dates and the word before a price on a cell
tokens.--color-busbar: the two silver lines across every cell, and rules and link underlines on the roof
tokens.--color-finger: the faint hairlines that run down every cell
tokens.--color-backsheet: the white sheet behind the cells: the gaps between them and their clipped corners
tokens.--color-frame: top and bottom rails of the module's aluminium frame
tokens.--color-frame-side: side rails of the frame and its thin edge lines
tokens.--color-roof: the slate roof under the module: the band across the top of the home page, list pages and the 404, dark in both schemes
tokens.--color-on-roof: headings, the phone number and links on the roof
tokens.--measure: widest a column of text may get
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between list items, under the call block's heading
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under headings, inside table rows, between a cell's title and its price
tokens.--space-3: standard gap: page side margin, between paragraphs, inside cells, between columns
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections, above and below the page content, and the roof's padding
tokens.--space-5: space above the call block and under the roof on wide screens
tokens.--tap-target: smallest height of anything meant to be tapped: menu links, the phone button
tokens.--focus-width: thickness of the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--frame: thickness of the module's aluminium frame
tokens.--cell-gap: width of the white gap between cells
tokens.--cell-clip: how much is cut from each corner of a cell, and how far the busbars sit from its top and bottom edges
tokens.--busbar: thickness of the thick silver rules on the page; busbars on cells are a pixel finer
